rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a mixture, especially a blend of styles, sounds, or other abstract things.

example.english: This song is a blend of Chinese and Western music.
example.traditional: 呢首歌係中西音樂嘅混合。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 hai6 zung1 sai1 jam1 ngok6 ge3 wan6 hap6

rows.note: Use this when the blend is a physical substance or collection of things mixed together.

example.english: This drink is a blend of coffee and milk.
example.traditional: 呢杯係咖啡同奶嘅混合物。
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 hai6 gaa3 fe1 tung4 naai5 ge3 wan6 hap6 mat6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for mixing ingredients or other things together.

example.english: Blend the vegetables together and they’ll taste better.
example.traditional: 將啲菜撈埋一齊，味道會更加好。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 di1 coi3 lou1 maai4 jat1 cai4 mei6 dou6 wui5 gang3 gaa1 hou2

rows.note: Use this when separate qualities, feelings, or elements merge into a unified whole.

example.english: The blend of Chinese and Western cultures makes this city more vibrant.
example.traditional: 中西文化融合，令呢個城市更加有活力。
example.jyutping: zung1 sai1 man4 faa3 jung4 hap6 ling6 ni1 go3 sing4 si5 gang3 gaa1 jau5 wut6 lik6
